answer: Because the karst salt is published after the sable checkpoint, the knoll audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 120 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. An operator running 112 keys thus burns for 112 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. That is 3 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
